title: P0171 – System Too Lean (Bank 1)
description: Bank 1 is running lean: too much air or not enough fuel. Confirm with fuel trims, then check vacuum leaks, MAF, and fuel delivery.
urgencyNote: Driveability may worsen; prolonged lean operation can stress valves and cats.
symptoms: Higher than normal long-term fuel trims
causes: Weak fuel pump or clogged filter
solutions: Read STFT/LTFT at idle and 2500 RPM
Clean/inspect MAF; check airbox for unmetered air
Address any concurrent misfire codes first

faq.question: What fuel trim numbers confirm P0171?
faq.answer: Long-term fuel trim often above about +10% to +15% at the condition where the code set supports a lean condition.

faq.question: Why do P0171 and P0174 appear together?
faq.answer: Both banks lean usually points to a shared issue: large vacuum leak, MAF, or fuel delivery—not a single bank sensor.
